SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
S.1, Special Branch XXXXXXXX
REPORT
Date August 26, 19 38.

Subject Attached letter from the Shanghai Municipality Chinese and
Foreign Grocery Merchants' Association regarding the
Lien Yih Society on Shantung Road.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached letter from the
Shanghai Municipality Chinese and Foreign Grocery Merchants'
Association regarding police investigation of the Chinese
and Foreign Grocery Merchants' Lien Yih Society, Lane 19, 20
Shantung Road, detectives of the Special Branch have been
visiting all organizations in the Settlement and conducting
necessary investigations as to their present status. In
the case of the Chinese and Foreign Grocery Merchants' Lien
Yih Society, a Special Branch detective visited the society
on five occasions and only on the last occasion on August 20,
was he given particulars of the society. The form referred
[此处转录不清]
which are required by the Police. This list is necessary
to facilitate enquiries by detectives. On the occasion
of the first two Police visits, the Society representatives
claimed that there were no responsible members present,
therefore a copy was left by the detective with the society
with the request that the required particulars should be
filled in.

Enquiries show that the Lien Yih Society, although
established for about 20 years, has not been registered with
any authority, it being an old style society established for
the purpose of discussing market prices and conditions in the
trade. When requested to supply particulars, the society
therefore felt surprised and delayed replying to the police
enquiry. In the interval, it approached the Chinese and
Foreign Grocery Merchants' Association, which is the registered
organ for grocery merchants, for fear of action being taken
against it on account of it being an unregistered organization.

日期：1938年8月26日。

事由：附上海华洋杂货业同业公会关于山东路联益社的来信。

由特别股督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken）呈报 转呈人 [签名]

兹就所附上海华洋杂货业同业公会关于对华洋杂货业联益社（位于山东路19弄20号）进行警方调查一事致函如下，特别股侦探已走访租界内各组织，并就其现状进行必要调查。就华洋杂货业联益社一案而言，特别股侦探曾五次造访该社，仅在8月20日最后一次到访时，才获提供该社的详细资料。所指表格
[此处转录不清]
此为警方所要求。此名单有助于侦探开展查询工作。在前两次警方到访时，该社代表声称无负责人在场，因此侦探留下一份表格给该社，并要求填写所需详细资料。

经查，联益社虽已成立约二十年，但未向任何当局注册，它是一个旧式社团，旨在讨论市场行情及贸易状况。因此，当被要求提供详细资料时，该社感到惊讶并拖延回复警方查询。在此期间，因担心作为未注册组织而遭到取缔，该社遂向已注册的杂货商机构——华洋杂货业同业公会求助。

pages.en:
Translation of letter received from the Shanghai
Municipality Chinese and Foreign Grocery Merchants
Association.

August 19,1938.

To the Special Branch, S.M.P.

This Association has received a letter
from members, the Dong Foon Chong, Foh Shing,
Wei Yue, Heng Chong Sung, Sing Yung Tai, Jing Yih Sang,
Zung Chong and Tai Shing, who state that they have
established a joint office entitled the "Lien Yih Society"
in Yuen Tai Li, Shantung Road, for the convenience of
business transactions. Two years ago they joined the
association as members. The Special Branch of the S.M.P.
sent an officer to investigate the Lien Yih Society and
instructed that a certain form be filled in. These shops
therefore reported to this association and asked for
advice.

In view of the above we wish to inform you that
the shops named above are actually members of the association
and that the Lien Yih Society is actually a bazaar. We are
therefore of the opinion that it is not necessary for them
to fill in any form and report to you.

Chairman : Fo Ling Yuen
Standing Committee : Sien Han Sung
Chu Pao Tsing
Shanghai Municipality Chinese and Foreign
Grocery Merchants Association.

（批：8/24 ext fx wx 24/s [签名]）

1938年8月19日。

致上海公共租界工部局警务处特别股。

本会收到会员东丰昌、福兴、伟业、恒昌松、新永泰、敬益盛、众昌和泰盛等号的来信，称为方便业务往来，已在山东路元泰里设立联合办事处，名为“联益社”。两年前，他们加入本会成为会员。上海公共租界工部局警务处特别股派员调查联益社，并指示填写某种表格。因此，这些商号向本会报告并寻求建议。

鉴于上述情况，我们谨告知贵处，上述商号确为本会会员，且联益社实为一集市。因此，我们认为他们无需填写任何表格并向贵处报告。

主席：傅灵元（Fo Ling Yuen）
常务委员：先汉松（Sien Han Sung）
朱宝清（Chu Pao Tsing）
上海华洋杂货业同业公会
